verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state ADK is model-agnostic and provides adapters for many providers including Gemini and locally running models, and GitHub README confirms 'ADK is model-agnostic, deployment-agnostic, and compatible with other frameworks,' directly supporting swapping LLM providers without rewriting agent logic. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of swapping providers in a real project and detail on how much code change (if any) is needed at the config level.
